recent_en: Axteria proposed a private placement of up to 78,844,309 new shares (10% of issued shares) on 7 October 2026 at an issue price of RM0.1121 per share, which was completed and listed on 3 November 2026, raising approximately RM8.84 million. The share price surged 43% during the period on five-year high trading volume. The latest quarterly report (period ended 30 June 2026) showed revenue up 44% year-on-year but a net loss of RM2.45 million.
notable_en: Completed private placement of 78,844,300 new shares at RM0.1121 each, raising approximately RM8.84 million.
The placement shares were listed on 3 November 2026, increasing issued share capital to 867,399,230 shares.
Proposed change of financial year end from 31 December to 30 June.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares representing 10% of issued shares dilutes existing shareholders by approximately 9.09%.
The latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM2.45 million, swinging from a profit in the same quarter last year.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM28.11 million, up 44% year-on-year and 23% quarter-on-quarter; however, it recorded a net loss of RM2.45 million with a net margin of -8.7%, compared to a net margin of 10.7% in the previous quarter.
